blocks.text: SOS Children’s Villages Pilipinas, in partnership with Pinoy Fitness Philippines, proudly announces Hope Run 2026: “I Keep Running for Hope,” a month-long fundraising run that will take place from November 1 to 30, 2026, in celebration of National Children’s Month. The virtual run aims to raise support for children and young people who are without, or at risk of losing parental care. Through this initiative, participants from across the country and around the world can run at their own pace while contributing to a meaningful cause.
